Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Rug Hug]]: a close-up of a flokati, a shaggy wool rug, for the card title's "rug" (Leia calls Chewbacca a "big walking carpet" in ''Star Wars'').

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flokati_rug_edge.jpg Flokati rug edge.jpg], Wikimedia Commons. Photograph by [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Jessamyn Jessamyn], 1 March 2020, own work. Resized from 3024 by 4032 to 1200 by 1600 pixels.
